lines.text: Want that or want you to?
Many learners say: I want that you help me.
Better: I want you to help me.
You to! I want you to help me.

data.wrong: I want that you help me.
data.right: I want you to help me.

native.tip: После want ставь “you to”: “I want you to help me.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I want that you help me”? 😅 По-русски «хочу, чтобы ты помог», и получается “want that you.” В английском нужно “want you to.” Правильно: “I want you to help me.” Послушай Карлоса и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “you to.” Нужно want you to. Скажи вслух: “I want you to help me.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: After want, use “you to”: “I want you to help me.”
en.caption: Do you also say “I want that you help me”? 😅 In Russian you say “I want that you help”, which gives “want that you”, but English needs “want you to.” Correct: “I want you to help me.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
